Issues with GDE flooding and catalyst activity over time were resolved by OCOchem’s significant development in the areas of (a) Gen 2 carbon paper-based gas diffusion electrodes and (b) modified electrochemical reactor’s process operating conditions. Although the demonstrated Vcell of 4.5V is higher than the 4.2V target, since the 85% FE value is better than the 70% target value, the resulting demonstrated electrical energy demand of 6310 kWh/ton-CO is much lower 2 than the 7000 kWh/ton-CO target. Thus, the higher FE more than compensates for the 2 higher Vcell. It should be noted that the demonstrated performance was obtained with OCOchem’s Gen 2 GDEs without incorporating MSU’s pore-graded metal structures. Table 3.
